Policy-side notes (not KB defects; recorded per Step 4):
1. The extended policies retire the base clause defining standard and preferred loans, yet the extended rules (both carry factors) and the base crediting rule ("loan collateral earns the credited rate of its loan type") still speak of "the credited rate of the policy's loan type"; the only definition is the compute binding collateral_rate. The KB states that definition in each carry document (preferred credited rate from the preferred loan first policy year, standard before it), consistent with compute.
2. ul_ext_loan_interest_settlement retires "interest ... is due on each anniversary; interest unpaid then is capitalized" while its own rule still says "before it falls due", "interest capitalized at earlier anniversaries" and "the next policy anniversary, when the interest would otherwise fall due". The KB renders both as the source has them.
3. charge_household_share: the rule gives the small share to an active annuity with "a smaller contract value", while compute gives the whole charge when the active contract value is 0 (`> 0` test). Not reached here (62480).
